'''Rasker Hill''' was a location on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It rested near the south ridge of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Several ancient ruins were located on top of the hill. A [[Farm/Legends|farm]] and a small village were interspersed nearby.

==History==
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] returned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|liberate]] it from the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], he met with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] at Rasker Hill. Their meeting was [[Battle of the south ridge|interrupted]] by elements of the Droid Army, but Sykes destroyed the interloping [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] and the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==Behind the scenes==
Rasker Hill appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. The player, assuming the role of Sykes, must defend Captain Panaka and destroy all the droid forces before triggering a cutsene and proceeding.
